acceptance_predicates.description: Selected runtime identity, path, descriptor, and permanent project binding are revalidated before read-only execution.
Bounded selector/runtime identity, replacement, publication-failure, and process-death tests reject unsafe outcomes.
Public upgrade and selector mutation remain rejection-only; the model is best-effort guidance.

definition_of_done: The selected-runtime consumer and its hostile evidence are present on one exact product revision.
Independent review and hosted checks pass at that exact revision.
No source-to-model refinement proof is required; unsupported mutation remains disabled.

inputs.description: Authenticated versioned-runtime and selector identity contracts.
Merged rejection-safe barrier and admission lifecycle.

outputs.description: An exact-head, independently reviewed, read-only selector/runtime audit.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before acceptance.
No public selector or upgrade mutation path is enabled.
